The learning rate follows the schedule  

\[
\text{lrate}=d_{\text{model}}^{-0.5}\;\min\bigl(\text{step\_num}^{-0.5},\;\text{step\_num}\times\text{warmup\_steps}^{-1.5}\bigr)
\]  

which means it **rises linearly** during the initial warm‑up phase (the first warmup_steps steps, set to 4000) and **then decays** proportionally to the inverse square‑root of the step number for the remainder of training [C:attention:20][C:attention:21].
